title: Pocketwire Rewards Aged Refund Clawback Schedule
content:
Pocketwire Rewards sets the clawback for an older merchant refund by the refund age, read from the purchase and refund dates on the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card ledger.

## Rule

The refund age is the number of calendar days from the purchase date to the refund date, the day after the purchase being day 1. The rate-method clawback is the refunded amount multiplied by the base earn rate of the tier held on the handling date, rounded up to whole points. The proportional clawback is the points the refunded purchase earned, counting its earning entry and any boost entry for it, multiplied by the refunded amount divided by the purchase amount, rounded up to whole points.

When the refund age is more than 60 days, the clawback is the rate-method clawback in place of the proportional clawback; when it is more than 30 but not more than 60 days, the clawback is the lower of the proportional clawback and the rate-method clawback. When the refund age is not more than 30 days, no such adjustment applies.

## Age bands

| Refund age | Clawback |
|---|---|
| more than 60 days | the rate-method clawback |
| more than 30, not more than 60 days | the lower of the proportional clawback and the rate-method clawback |
| not more than 30 days | no such adjustment |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical purchase dated 1 March 2025)

| Refund dated | Refund age | Band |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2025 | 30 days | not more than 30 days |
| 1 April 2025 | 31 days | lower of the two |
| 30 April 2025 | 60 days | lower of the two |
| 1 May 2025 | 61 days | rate method |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- A refund of 40.00 USD on a tier with a base earn rate of 1.5 points per USD: the rate-method clawback is 60 points. With a proportional clawback of 85 points and a refund age of 45 days, the clawback is the lower, 60 points. With a refund age of 75 days it is 60 points whatever the proportional clawback.
- A refund of 33.33 USD at a base earn rate of 1.25: 41.6625, rounded up to 42 points.
